items.question: What happens to the world when a woman fumigates her own house, clothes, and body?
premises: A woman fumigates her own house, clothes, and body.
The world approaches delusion like a servant.
The result is tied to her ritual action.
items.inference: The fumigation ritual makes the world approach delusion as if it were her servant.
uncertainties: The exact fumigation substance and ritual context are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Whoever fumigates her own house, clothes, and body, the world approaches delusion like a servant.
